title: Paul Hellyer briefed by Greer, press conference in Toronto

tellings.link_reason: Both are about Paul Hellyer, Canada's former defence minister, going public about UFOs.

plain: Paul Hellyer, a former Canadian minister of defence, went public about UFOs, and the claim is that he did so partly because a UFO activist named Steven Greer briefed him. Greer tells Michels this himself, as someone who took part: he says 'I was one of the reasons why he came out publicly,' and that the two of them held a press conference together in Toronto. A guest named Charlie Foltz also brings Hellyer up on another episode, as an example of a senior official who came forward describing UFOs, though he calls him the prime minister of Canada and says nothing about Greer or Toronto. If true, it would mean a former head of a national defence ministry put his name behind the subject, with Greer's help.
